falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug pattern would be broken, as that bottom formation required lower lows and failed recovery attempts; a clean breakout above pre-correction resistance invalidates the bottoming thesis and suggests the pattern match was a false positive

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 indicates elevated stress/uncertainty; sustained VIX compression below 14 would prove the stress was transient and the 'bottom' was actually just noise, not genuine capitulation, making the UNKNOWN verdict premature

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 5+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A bottom_2024_aug analog requires specific rate dynamics (rates stabilizing or rising into the bottom); if yields collapse into flight-to-safety mode, the macro regime is different—this would prove the pattern match failed and the current signal is misaligned with actual conditions

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
